instruction: Could you please open the Google Scholar page of Linxi Fan in Chrome?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('f11'); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.scroll(-40)

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding Linxi (Jim) Fan (third author) from the PDF and opening his Google Scholar page. Linxi Fan's Google Scholar user ID is PIBY7qwAAAAJ. The evaluator checks if the URL contains both 'https://scholar.google.com/citations' and 'user=PIBY7qwAAAAJ'.
metadata.verification: Verified Linxi Fan's Google Scholar ID by checking the third author in the paper. Task maintains same difficulty as original - finding a different co-author's Scholar page.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks ALL instruction requirements - both the correct Google Scholar domain AND the correct person (Linxi Fan via user ID PIBY7qwAAAAJ)
Getter logic correct: get_active_url_from_accessTree (chrome.py:710-800) extracts active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree by reading the address bar element, returns URL string
Metric logic correct: is_expected_url_pattern_match (chrome.py:70-99) implements proper ALL-pattern matching - iterates through all patterns and returns 0.0 if ANY fails, 1.0 only if ALL match

Expected values semantically correct: Pattern 'https://scholar.google.com/citations' verifies Google Scholar citations page, pattern 'user=PIBY7qwAAAAJ' verifies Linxi Fan's specific Scholar ID (confirmed in metadata)
Data flow correct: getter extracts URL string → metric receives rules dict directly (correct for type='rule') → accesses rules['expected'] → performs re.search() on each pattern
Pattern matching appropriate: re.search() allows flexible matching of domain in URL and user ID parameter anywhere in URL string
Postconfig present: Task includes postconfig to launch Chrome, ensuring browser is available for verification at runtime
Edge cases handled: Getter has extensive logging and error handling, metric handles empty/None results by returning 0.0
validation.rule_validation_notes: Previous heuristic warning about missing postconfig was false positive - postconfig already present at lines 64-79 launching Chrome before verification
